summary: What I do not understand is why @wired isn't covering how @amazon sells the largest piracy device in history. In the open, with zero consequence or pushback from Hollywood. No way they don't know people buy millions of cracked fire sticks.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: What I do not understand is why @wired isn't covering how @amazon sells the largest piracy device in history. In the open, with zero consequence or pushback from Hollywood. No way they don't know people buy millions of cracked fire sticks.
